enums.name: TabOwner
enums.description: Who a tab belongs to. An unattributed tab is the user's, because the rules that protect a user's tab are the stricter ones.

members.name: UNKNOWN
members.description: Unattributed, and therefore treated as the user's.

members.name: USER
members.description: The person opened it.

members.name: ASSISTANT
members.description: Taffy opened it inside an approved task scope.

enums.name: TabPrivacy
enums.description: Whether a tab forgets everything when it closes.

members.name: NORMAL
members.description: An ordinary tab.

members.name: PRIVATE
members.description: A private tab; nothing about it is a source and nothing about it is kept.

enums.name: NavigationFailure
enums.description: What a failed navigation was, in the vocabulary the parity matrix uses. A member this build does not name fails closed as a failure and never as a load.

members.name: NONE
members.description: The navigation committed a real document.

members.name: DNS_FAILURE
members.description: The host could not be resolved.

members.name: OFFLINE
members.description: The device has no usable network; the retry advice differs from a lost connection.

members.name: CONNECTION_FAILURE
members.description: The connection could not be established or was lost mid-flight.

members.name: TIMEOUT
members.description: The server did not answer in time.

members.name: TLS_FAILURE
members.description: The handshake or the certificate failed.

members.name: HTTP_ERROR_STATUS
members.description: A 4xx or 5xx whose body committed: a real document, but not the requested one.

members.name: BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT
members.description: A client-side policy stopped it.

members.name: BLOCKED_BY_SAFE_BROWSING
members.description: Safe Browsing stopped it; never reclassified, because the parity row exists to catch that.

members.name: ABORTED
members.description: The person or the browser cancelled it. Never reported as an error.

members.name: UNKNOWN_FAILURE
members.description: A failure this table does not name; the page did not load.

enums.name: InterstitialKind
enums.description: Which trusted browser surface stood between the person and the content.

members.name: NONE
members.description: Nothing did.

members.name: CERTIFICATE_ERROR
members.description: A certificate interstitial.

members.name: SAFE_BROWSING
members.description: A Safe Browsing interstitial.

members.name: BLOCKED_BY_POLICY
members.description: A policy interstitial.

members.name: OTHER
members.description: One this build does not recognise; that a trusted surface is showing is the part no caller may lose.

enums.name: DownloadState
enums.description: Where a download has got to, mirroring the download system's own lifecycle plus the paused sub-state it reports separately.

members.name: CREATED
members.description: Created and not yet given a target. Nothing is on disk.

members.name: IN_PROGRESS
members.description: Bytes are arriving.

members.name: PAUSED
members.description: Held by the person or by the system.

members.name: INTERRUPTED
members.description: Stopped by a failure; whether it can resume is a separate field.

members.name: COMPLETE
members.description: The file is on the device.

members.name: CANCELLED
members.description: Ended before it finished, deliberately.

enums.name: DownloadFailure
enums.description: Why a download stopped, translated from the download system's interrupt reason and never invented.

members.name: NONE
members.description: It did not stop.

members.name: NETWORK
members.description: The network failed.

members.name: SERVER
members.description: The server failed.

members.name: FILE_SYSTEM
members.description: Writing the file failed.

members.name: INSUFFICIENT_SPACE
members.description: There is not enough room.

members.name: PERMISSION_DENIED
members.description: The platform refused the write.

members.name: BLOCKED_BY_SECURITY_CHECK
members.description: A security check stopped it; reported honestly and never worked around.

members.name: CANCELLED_BY_USER
members.description: The person stopped it.

members.name: BROWSER_SHUTDOWN
members.description: The browser went away.

members.name: UNKNOWN
members.description: A reason this translation does not name; treated as a failure, never a success.

enums.name: DownloadDestination
enums.description: Where the bytes are going, as a kind rather than a path: a record that may reach a log carries no profile directory layout.

members.name: UNDECIDED
members.description: No target yet.

members.name: DEFAULT_DIRECTORY
members.description: The platform's downloads directory.

members.name: USER_CHOSEN_LOCATION
members.description: A location the person picked.

members.name: APPLICATION_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY
members.description: The application's own private storage.

enums.name: DownloadCommand
enums.description: What a person may ask of a download. Which of these is legal in which state is the browser's decision, not the surface's.

members.name: PAUSE
members.description: Hold it.

members.name: RESUME
members.description: Continue an authorized transfer.

members.name: CANCEL
members.description: End it.

members.name: RETRY
members.description: Start a fresh request, which is a fresh decision and not a resume.

members.name: OPEN_WHEN_COMPLETE
members.description: Open it once the bytes have finished arriving.

members.name: OPEN_NOW
members.description: Open it now; legal only for a finished download.

enums.name: BrowsingStatus
enums.description: One terminal verdict for one browsing intent. It says whether the browser took the request, never whether the page loaded.

members.name: ACCEPTED
members.description: The browser took the request and owns it from here.

members.name: INVALID_REQUEST
members.description: A field was absent, malformed, or over a declared bound.

members.name: UNKNOWN_TAB
members.description: No tab of this profile carries that identity.

members.name: UNKNOWN_DOWNLOAD
members.description: No download of this profile carries that identity.

members.name: ILLEGAL_IN_STATE
members.description: The request is well formed and the thing it names is not in a state that admits it.

members.name: REFUSED_BY_POLICY
members.description: A browser rule refused it — the assistant may not close a person's tab, or take focus from what they are reading.

members.name: NO_HISTORY
members.description: There is nowhere to go in that direction.

members.name: UNAVAILABLE
members.description: No browser window is attached to answer this profile right now.

structs.name: TabView
structs.description: One open tab as a surface sees it. No browser object and no full location crosses this record.

fields.name: tab_id
fields.description: Opaque tab identity, unique within a profile.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The page title as the page gave it.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The host, shown instead of a location.

fields.name: has_been_nowhere
fields.description: Whether this tab has been to no page at all. Carried rather than inferred from an empty host, because a data: or file: page has no host either and a surface that read blankness as emptiness would draw over content the web served.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Who the tab belongs to.

fields.name: privacy
fields.description: Whether it forgets everything when it closes.

fields.name: selected
fields.description: Whether this is the tab the person is looking at.

structs.name: NavigationView
structs.description: What the selected tab is showing. A failure is a state of the navigation rather than a separate screen: the engine owns the behaviour and the product owns the wording.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The host of the committed document.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The page title as the page gave it.

fields.name: can_go_back
fields.description: Whether there is history behind this page.

fields.name: can_go_forward
fields.description: Whether there is history ahead of it.

fields.name: is_loading
fields.description: Whether the page is still arriving.

fields.name: failure
fields.description: Why the page did not load, or NONE.

fields.name: interstitial
fields.description: Which trusted surface is showing instead of the page, or NONE.

fields.name: http_status_code
fields.description: The committed response code, or zero when nothing committed.

fields.name: filtering_active
fields.description: Whether ad and tracker blocking is acting on this page: the master setting is on and no site exception names this host.

fields.name: blocked_request_count
fields.description: How many requests filtering has blocked on the committed page so far. Publication is coalesced, so the number may jump, never lie; it resets when a navigation commits.

structs.name: DownloadView
structs.description: One download. Sizes are bytes and the surface formats them; the full target path is deliberately absent.

fields.name: download_id
fields.description: Opaque download identity, allocated by the download system.

fields.name: file_name
fields.description: Base name only, as the download system settled it after any uniquifying.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The host the file came from.

fields.name: received_bytes
fields.description: Bytes written so far.

fields.name: total_bytes
fields.description: Total size, meaningful only when total_known is true.

fields.name: total_known
fields.description: Whether the server said how large the file is. A surface that shows a bar rather than a spinner has to know which it has, and a sentinel in the size would be read as a size.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Where the download has got to.

fields.name: failure
fields.description: Why it stopped, or NONE.

fields.name: destination
fields.description: Where the bytes are going, as a kind.

fields.name: resumable
fields.description: Whether the download system reports it can continue from where it stopped.

fields.name: requires_danger_confirmation
fields.description: Whether the danger checks want an explicit confirmation before the file is opened or kept.

structs.name: BrowsingStateView
structs.description: Everything a browsing surface draws, in one snapshot, so that two of its three lists can never disagree about which tab is selected.

fields.name: tabs
fields.description: Every open tab, in the order a switcher shows them.

fields.name: navigation
fields.description: What the selected tab is showing.

fields.name: downloads
fields.description: Every download this profile knows about.

interfaces.name: TaffyBrowsingObserver
interfaces.description: The surface half of the browsing seam. It receives whole snapshots and never a delta, because a delta is a second description of the same state and the two drift.

methods.name: OnBrowsingState
methods.description: One complete description of what the surface should be drawing.

interfaces.name: TaffyBrowsingSurface
interfaces.description: The whole of what a surface may ask of the browser about tabs, navigation and downloads. No browser object crosses it, and a surface cannot reach past it: what a command is allowed to do is decided behind this seam, never in front of it.

methods.name: Observe
methods.description: Hand the browser the observer this surface will receive snapshots on.

params.name: observer
params.description: The surface's observer, bound for the life of the connection.

methods.name: OpenTab
methods.description: Open a tab on a host and select it.

params.name: privacy
params.description: Whether the new tab forgets everything when it closes.

response.name: tab_id
response.description: The identity of the new tab, empty unless the status is ACCEPTED.

params.name: tab_id
params.description: Tab identity taken from a snapshot.

methods.name: CloseTab
methods.description: Close a tab. Closing the last of the person's tabs opens a new one, as a browser does.

params.name: tab_id
params.description: Tab identity taken from a snapshot.

methods.name: NavigateTo
methods.description: Navigate the selected tab to a host.

methods.name: GoBack
methods.description: Go back in the selected tab.

response.name: status
response.description: Terminal verdict; NO_HISTORY when there is nowhere to go.

methods.name: GoForward
methods.description: Go forward in the selected tab.

response.name: status
response.description: Terminal verdict; NO_HISTORY when there is nowhere to go.

methods.name: RunDownloadCommand
methods.description: Ask something of one download. Whether the command is legal in the download's current state is answered here, so no surface carries a copy of that table.

params.name: download_id
params.description: Download identity taken from a snapshot.

response.name: status
response.description: Terminal verdict; ILLEGAL_IN_STATE when the state does not admit the command.

methods.name: SetFilteringEnabled
methods.description: Turn ad and tracker blocking on or off for the whole profile. A person configuring their own browser: no assistant authority moves, so this is a browsing command and never a core-service one.

methods.name: SetSiteFilteringException
methods.description: Record or remove one site's exception from blocking. The site is a host, never a location, for the same reason nothing else on this seam carries one.

params.name: allow
params.description: True records the exception, so blocking stands down on that site; false removes it.

response.name: status
response.description: Terminal verdict; INVALID_REQUEST for a host over the declared bound.
